circuits.detail: Glyphosate and ALS-inhibitor herbicides losing effectiveness against resistant weed biotypes

IPM scouting not detecting early resistance patches before they spread field-wide
Biological and cultural control alternatives underdeveloped as herbicide dependency persists
Application technology unable to deliver site-specific treatments targeting resistant weed patches

issues.label: Pollinator Decline

circuits.detail: Neonicotinoid seed treatments and foliar applications causing lethal and sublethal pollinator effects
Herbicide drift eliminating flowering habitat adjacent to crop fields where pollinators forage
Scouting protocols not including pollinator activity assessment before spray decisions
IPM threshold-based decisions not incorporating pollinator risk into spray timing calculations

Resistance management compromised as emergency applications use same mode of action repeatedly

IPM decision models not integrating real-time weather data for disease risk forecasting
